Name: Giants and Dwarves
Author: ttxxxxx1
Description:
Description
Let your character zoom in and out infinitely

Installation Instructions
Install the latest version of SMAPI
Extract the mod folder to the Stardew Valley/Mods directory
Run the game using SMAPI

PGUP to zoom in on the character
PGDN to zoom out on the character

Compatibility
No known mod conflicts at the moment

Trees and houses may block your character. This might be fixed in future updates.

Thanks to everyone who inspired or helped you. ...
